name: Teabowl with Tortoiseshell Glaze
material: Brown-glazed stoneware with "tortoiseshell" pattern, Jizhou ware
summary: This teacup with a so-called tortoiseshell glaze is a fine example of southern ware from Jizhou, where potters specialized in brown splashed glazes sometimes resembling partridge feathers or tortoise shells.
